subject.title: fix(gateway): add per-request cancellation to prevent late node.invoke dispatch

question: Should Gateway request cancellation use caller deadline metadata on each request or an explicit cancel frame keyed by request id?
rationale: The existing wire request carries neither the client timeout nor its abort event; choosing the permanent contract determines security ordering, compatibility, and pending-versus-effecting semantics.

options.title: Add deadline metadata
options.body: Transmit a validated caller deadline with each request and abort pending server work when that boundary expires.

options.title: Add a cancel frame
options.body: Send an additive cancellation message and track pending, effecting, and completed request state server-side.

options.title: Use a node-only interim limit
options.body: Temporarily constrain a documented server timeout to approval-bearing `node.invoke` calls while deferring the complete protocol.

recommendation.title: Add deadline metadata
recommendation.body: Transmit a validated caller deadline with each request and abort pending server work when that boundary expires.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical issue authored by steipete defines the security boundary and explicitly calls for an additive negotiated request-cancellation capability.
